items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: he was on with Louis Armstrong. He's the one who got Louis on there.

ctx.x: he was on with Louis Armstrong. He's the one who got Louis on there. You see, during that time, when he got Louis on there, he would went to playing alto. See, after he lost his amateur on trumpet, he picked up alto. The alto horn. Yeah, the alto horn. The melaphone. Yeah, melaphone. Well, he's the one who got Louis' job on there. Yeah. Louis was playing trumpet, and he was playing alto.
